stem.text: Ammonia is produced by the Haber process.
A fault in the temperature control during the process resulted in the temperature changing to $600\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ for two hours.
What effect did this have on the ammonia production during this time?

A.text: Ammonia was formed faster. The equilibrium yield decreased.

B.text: Ammonia was formed faster. The equilibrium yield increased.

C.text: Ammonia was formed slower. The equilibrium yield decreased.

D.text: Ammonia was formed slower. The equilibrium yield increased.
